evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Declarative announcement of a technology decision supplies the controlling fact of the change itself.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch that simultaneously frames offered benefits as incentives.
Summary notation restates the migration as an established fact, controlling the informational frame.
Quantified performance claim presented as evidence supporting the decision.
Fixed deadline notation imposes a time-bound expectation on the migration.
